profile.headline: Software Developer | Computer Science
profile.summary:
Graduated from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse in 2019 with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, bringing a strong foundation in software development and technical problem-solving.  

Contributed to Alternative Solutions Inc. from July 2019 to May 2026 as a Software Developer and Software Developer II, focusing on CI/CD processes and RESTful Web Services. Dedicated to leveraging technical skills for developing impactful solutions that enhance user experiences and streamline operations.
